attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post, written in his own voice and endorsed.

semantics.note: The normalised wording keeps both the 'so far as I know' hedge and the 'arguably' securities-fraud exception. It is a hedged observation about US law as of 2023-08-17.

contract.note: The contract rightly keeps the knowledge hedge. Showing what the law was would not show the limits of what Marcus knew, so it is fair not to turn this into a firm legal claim. 'Wholesale misinformation' is also undefined.

reviews.rationale: The claim is limited to the speaker's own knowledge ('so far as I know'), the exception is open-ended ('arguably', 'very restricted domains'), and 'wholesale misinformation' is undefined. Evidence about the law cannot confirm or refute what he knew, and the packet has no evidence items. Nothing is broken; the claim is simply too hedged to score, so it is not_adjudicable.
